subject: session: load variables before parsing SQL (#51466)
summary: Adds an early `loadCommonGlobalVariablesIfNeeded()` call in `session.Parse` so parser/lexer settings (notably `sql_mode`, e.g. `NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES`) are applied before parsing the first user query; includes a regression test validating a fresh connection honors global `sql_mode` during parsing.
